title: The Gaze of the Cosmic Eye
next_chapter_hook: Before Chen Ji could recover from the shock, the low voice of the Cosmic Eye sounded again—it was about to tell him a secret that the Heavenly Dao's Eye least desired to be known.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji took all of his father's inheritance into his palm, the incomplete Tianji Record deep within his Mental Sea suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light. That radiance shattered his spiritual barrier, spreading toward the depths of the Void, as if to announce throughout the Three Realms—a new Chess Player had been born.

However, in the next instant, what Chen Ji felt was not the pleasure of power filling him, but an unprecedented sense of oppression. It was as if the entire heavens and earth were pressing down upon him, and as if a pair of invisible eyes were piercing through the endless Void, staring fixedly at him.

The blue stone ground beneath his feet began to crack, fine fissures spreading outward from where he stood. On the distant Tianqing Peak, the disciples gathered for the ceremony clutched their chests, faces pale—though they couldn't perceive the phenomenon Chen Ji witnessed, they clearly felt that heaven-shaking pressure.

"Is this... the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, his pupils constricting. He had expected that fury to manifest as devastating, thunderous destruction, never imagining—what descended was merely a consciousness, a consciousness far beyond his cognitive realm, transcending the Three Realms.

A rift suddenly tore open in the Void, its edges burning with chaotic purple flames, the interior a bottomless abyss of darkness. Within that deepest darkness, an eye slowly opened—an eye composed of countless stars, its pupil swirling with visions of the universe's primordial birth.

dialogue.content: "I am the Cosmic Eye, the third extreme existence transcending Heavenly Dao and the mortal realm." The voice resounded directly in the depths of his consciousness, both statement and declaration, "For thousands upon thousands of years, no one has dared to gaze upon my true form. You are the first."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his spiritual sense trembling beneath that gaze, like a small boat facing the vast ocean. He wanted to retreat, yet discovered his body immobilized by some force, utterly unable to move. This was not the domineering pressure of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, but a more ancient, more distant power—it merely looked at him, yet already made him feel insignificant as dust.

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Dao's Eye treats all prophets throughout history as chess pieces; the Tianji Record is merely one of its pieces placed in the mortal realm." The Cosmic Eye's voice was terrifyingly calm, "And you, Chen Ji, are merely a new piece selected on the chessboard. But I have come to tell you a secret—"

text.content: "You... are not the only chessboard." The giant eye composed of stars subtly turned, countless galaxies rotating, colliding, and being reborn within its pupil, "In my vision, there are countless versions of you, countless possibilities. But you chose the most difficult path—breaking the chains, reshaping Heavenly Dao."

dialogue.content: "I admire your choice." The Cosmic Eye's voice suddenly dropped lower, "I can give you power, give you the method to defeat the Heavenly Dao's Eye. But there is no free lunch in this world—I require you to make a promise."

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the shock in his heart, striving to keep his voice steady. He slowly spoke, his voice echoing in the Void: "What kind of promise?" He knew he was conversing with an unprecedented existence, and any hasty answer could bring unbearable consequences.

dialogue.content: "I need you to do one thing for me after you defeat the Heavenly Dao's Eye." The Cosmic Eye's pupil spun faster, galaxies accelerating within it, "But what this thing is, it is not yet time to tell you. You only need to know—I will not let you destroy everything you cherish."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. This promise was far too vague, vague to the point where he couldn't judge what traps it might conceal. Accepting meant surrendering his fate to an unknown variable; refusing meant losing a chance that could potentially change the battlefield.

He raised his head, gazing directly at the giant eye composed of stars, his eyes flickering with complex light. The Tianji Record trembled slightly in his Mental Sea, as if also awaiting his decision. Mo Xiansheng's voice arose in the depths of his consciousness: "Be careful—the Cosmic Eye's deals are never simple."

"I need time to consider." Chen Ji slowly spoke, his voice calm as still water, "Though the senior's proposal is enticing, there are still too many unknowns for the junior. Before making a decision, the junior wishes to know more."

dialogue.content: "Time?" The Cosmic Eye uttered a low laugh, that laughter carrying the vicissitudes of antiquity, "Your time is far less than you think. The Heavenly Dao's Eye has already begun acting; every choice you make is within its calculations."

text.content: "But I can give you a reason, allowing you to decide more quickly." The giant eye suddenly drew nearer, countless stars seeming ready to pour forth from the pupil, "What the Heavenly Dao's Eye fears most is not destruction, but forgetting."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. This sentence struck like thunder in his mind. Forgetting... what the Heavenly Dao's Eye fears is forgetting? Its existence, is it related to being remembered? Countless thoughts surged through his mind, the Tianji Record's fragments flipping frantically, as if also attempting to解析 this shocking secret.

choice.prompt: The Cosmic Eye's deal lies before you, each choice leading toward an unknown fate. What will you do?

choices.description: Accept the Cosmic Eye's proposal, gain the power to defeat the Heavenly Dao's Eye, but at the cost of having to fulfill an unknown promise in the future.
choices.visible_reward: Method to Defeat the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.risk_hint: The Cosmic Eye's promise cost is unknown, possibly a destructive trap

text.content: "Good." Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision, "I accept your terms. But I hope this promise will not violate my bottom line." His voice was firm, yet carried a hint of caution.

dialogue.content: "Very well." A note of satisfaction appeared in the Cosmic Eye's voice, "Your caution is precisely why you have survived in this chess game until now. I will not disappoint you—now, remember what I have told you. The Heavenly Dao's Eye fears forgetting, meaning its power derives from the memories of all beings. What you must do is find a way to make it forgotten."

choices.description: Reject the Cosmic Eye's proposal, maintain independence, but lose the channel to obtain crucial information.
choices.risk_hint: Rejecting may provoke the Cosmic Eye, and lose the opportunity to understand the Heavenly Dao's Eye's weaknesses

text.content: "Thank you deeply for your kindness, senior." Chen Ji slightly cupped his hands, his voice calm yet resolute, "But the junior does not wish to surrender his fate to an unknown promise. Please forgive the junior for being unable to accept."

dialogue.content: The Cosmic Eye fell silent for a moment, the pupil composed of stars slightly constricting, as if reassessing this insignificant existence before it. "Interesting." It finally spoke, its voice betraying neither joy nor anger, "You are quite special, Chen Ji. But I shall give you a piece of advice—sometimes, rejection is also a form of arrogance."

choices.description: Attempt to negotiate with the Cosmic Eye, strive for clearer promise terms and a lower price.
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Cosmic Eye, and may expose one's weaknesses during negotiations

text.content: "Senior, forgive the junior for speaking frankly." Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze clear and resolute, "An unknown promise is far too risky for the junior. The junior wishes to know the specific content of this promise, even if just a direction."

dialogue.content: The giant eye gazed at him, as if weighing his value. After a moment, it slowly spoke: "You are clever, knowing to seize the initiative in negotiations. Very well, I can give you a hint—this promise is related to my layout in this world, related to your sister."

text.content: Before Chen Ji could recover from the shock of this sentence, the low voice of the Cosmic Eye sounded again: "Your sister Chen Nian is used by the Heavenly Dao's Eye as the key to sealing my power. But this is also her fortune—she is the only one capable of interfering with the Tianji Record's foresight. Now you understand? Why I said this promise is related to her."

The giant eye composed of stars slowly retreated, re-concealing itself within the darkness of the Void's depths. But before disappearing, it left one final sentence: "In three days, the Heavenly Dao's Eye will send an emissary. That is the moment you prove your worth, and the moment you make your final choice. Consider carefully, Chen Ji. I await you on the other shore."

The Void closed, and peace returned to heaven and earth. But Chen Ji knew everything had changed. In his hand he held his father's inheritance, in his mind echoed the Cosmic Eye's revelations, and in his heart he weighed反复 that unknown promise. The Tianji Record floated quietly in his Mental Sea, as if also awaiting his decision.
